content.text:
**Finding: missing (critical)** — the MSA has no proprietary rights / ownership article.

What I checked:
- Ownership-adjacent provisions are only warranties: Kubient warrants it owns the Service/Auction Platform (p0039–p0040), AP warrants it owns the Content and Properties (p0043), plus the trademark carve-out in 14(b) (p0065) and the survival reference to "proprietary rights" in 14(f) (p0070) — which points to a clause that does not exist.
- p0025 makes AP "responsible and solely liable" for the Content and its IP rights without ever confirming AP *owns* it.
- No treatment of deliverables/work product (p0033 references "deliverables" but only for infringement), and no treatment of the "Requests" data and visitor data Kubient collects, stores and measures (p0011, p0035).

Direction check: there is no affirmative assignment of AP IP or data to Kubient and no joint ownership, so the walk-away line is not crossed — but the preferred position is unmet.

Redline (validated ok:true): new subsection 6(b) "Proprietary Rights" inserted after p0025, providing that AP exclusively owns the Content, Properties, Requests and all Customer Data; Kubient retains the Auction Platform and pre-existing IP; Kubient assigns deliverables created for AP with a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license back for embedded Kubient IP; no transfer of AP IP/data to Kubient and no joint ownership; Kubient may use Customer Data only to provide the Services.
